reason: S1 removes the timeout API used directly by H0, so the harness can no longer compile and reach LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput without maintenance. This gap did not exist with S0.
evidence: H0 calls h2o_timeout_val_from_uint while initializing config.http2.idle_timeout, config.http1.req_timeout, config.proxy timeouts, and proxy_config timeouts.
S1 deletes include/h2o/timeout_val.h, including h2o_timeout_val_from_uint, and introduces h2o_timer_val_from_uint in include/h2o/timer_val.h.
S1 changes the corresponding public fields and h2o_proxy_register_reverse_proxy parameter from h2o_timeout_val_t to h2o_timer_val_t.
recommended_action: Update fuzz/driver.cc to replace h2o_timeout_val_from_uint with h2o_timer_val_from_uint so H0 builds against S1 and retains its existing HTTP1/HTTP2 and reverse-proxy coverage.
